title: Geometric Mayer–Vietoris rows with distinguished-triangle presentations
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram and c a colimit cocone with IsColimit witness. Fix i∈I, a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], and s₀:X→Spec(R_i), locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules on every scheme exist in the fixed universe w. Let U,V be opens of X with U compact and V affine. Let t:Y→X be an open immersion with range U∪V, and s:Y→Spec(R_i) equal to t≫s₀, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the localized module-site derived categories on every open of Y exist in universe w. Fix perfect P,Q in D(O_Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there exist a five-term complex S in the category of tail-indexed abelian-group diagrams, a five-term complex B of abelian groups at the limit, and a row morphism κ from S to the constant diagram on B. The middle diagram S₂ has equivalences e_j to Hom(P_j,Q_j) identifying its transitions with perfectStageMap, and B₂ has an equivalence b to Hom(P_limit,Q_limit) identifying κ₂,j with perfectLimitMap. For r=0,1,3,4 the induced map colim(S_r)→B_r has PerfectHomLocalMap(U,V,-). No exactness of the colimit row and no supplied set Hom system is asserted. Instead of asserting exactness, it supplies, for each of the three consecutive short complexes and each stage (and at the limit), a scheme Z, an object M in its derived category, a distinguished triangle T, and a short-complex isomorphism to additive Hom(M,T), enlarged by ULift to the group universe. These presentation witnesses, not exactness hypotheses, are the input of the categorical exactness lemma.

proof.text: Pull the cover U,V back to the presenting scheme Y and all its ring stages. Restrict the local strictly perfect models using the localized derived pullback comparison, so restrictions remain perfect; shifts remain perfect by thick closure. Perfect Q has quasi-coherent cohomology. The preimages of the two compact opens are compact and their intersection is compact by quasi-separatedness.

proof.text: Construct the five-term Hom rows from the functorial Mayer–Vietoris triangles. The three short complexes come respectively from the rotation of the original triangle shifted by -1, the inverse rotation of the original triangle, and the original triangle itself. Shift comparisons and sign isomorphisms identify the connecting maps. Derived open adjunction and biproduct Hom identify their terms; triangle relations give zero composites. Retain the distinguished triangles and short-complex isomorphisms as witnesses, without asserting exactness.

proof.text: For a transition h apply the direct-image Mayer--Vietoris comparison to Lh*Q and then its naturality to the adjunction unit Q -> Rh*Lh*Q. Applying Hom(P,-) and derived adjunction gives all four commuting squares, including the connecting morphism. Identify the local comparisons through open restriction. At the central term cancellation of the counit-pinned composition comparisons gives exactly perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap. Explicitly, the adjunction unit sends a stage arrow f to f followed by the unit on Q. Its adjunct is pullback(f), followed by pullback of that unit and the counit at the pulled-back Q. The adjunction triangle identity cancels the last two factors. Conjugating by the fixed composition comparisons is exactly perfectStageMap. The identical calculation for a cocone leg gives perfectLimitMap. The pinned direct-image composition comparisons on opens identify units with units of composite adjunctions, so the same cancellation supplies the local representative equations.

proof.text: For each of the four neighboring terms retain the restricted perfect pair and its stage Hom presentation; use perfect_hom_stage_colimit. Underlying-set preservation and filtered finite-product preservation identify their induced maps with the basic, product, and equivalence constructors of PerfectHomLocalMap. No exactness of the group colimit is used.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_stage_rows_core
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    : ∃ (S : ComposableArrows (Set.Ici i ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u w}) 4)
        (B : ComposableArrows AddCommGrpCat.{max u w} 4)
        (κ : S ⟶ B ⋙ Functor.const (Set.Ici i))
        (e : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, (S.obj' 2).obj j ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q))
        (b : B.obj' 2 ≃
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
           (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
        ∃ (hS : S.IsComplex) (hB : B.IsComplex),
        (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 2 ≤ 4) (j : Set.Ici i),
          ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Z)
            (T : Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
            (hT : T ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Z)),
            Nonempty (((S.sc hS r hr).map
              ((evaluation (Set.Ici i) AddCommGrpCat.{max u w}).obj j)) ≅
              (shortComplexOfDistTriangle T hT).map
                ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op M)) ⋙
                  AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u}))) ∧
        (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 2 ≤ 4),
          ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Z)
            (T : Triangle (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
            (hT : T ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory Z)),
            Nonempty ((B.sc hB r hr) ≅
              (shortComplexOfDistTriangle T hT).map
                ((preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op M)) ⋙
                  AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u}))) ∧
        (∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : (S.obj' 2).obj j),
          e k ((S.obj' 2).map (homOfLE hjk) f) =
            perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (e j f)) ∧
        (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : (S.obj' 2).obj j),
          b ((κ.app ⟨2, by decide⟩).app j f) =
            perfectLimitMap R c s j.property (e j f)) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 0) ⟨B.obj' 0, κ.app ⟨0, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 1) ⟨B.obj' 1, κ.app ⟨1, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 3) ⟨B.obj' 3, κ.app ⟨3, by decide⟩⟩) ∧
        PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
          (colimit.desc (S.obj' 4) ⟨B.obj' 4, κ.app ⟨4, by decide⟩⟩)
